opinions.text: In error to the Court of Appeals of the District of Columbia. January 18, 1909. Dismissed with costs on motion of Mr. Solicitor General Hoyt for the plaintiff in error. The Attorney General for plaintiff in error. Mr. Charles J. Kappler, Mr: Charles H. Merillat, Mr. James K. Jones and Mr. Charles M: Fechheimer for defendants in error in Nos. 371, 372 and 373. No appearance for defendant in error in No. 374.
